notes:
GymnasiumDriver package for the legacy Webots Supervisor environment WebotsStickEnv. The fake backend is a pure-Python analytic F0 stand-in and is the only backend checked; it mirrors the upstream Discrete(2) action space, fixed four-zero reset, wheel-direction rule, thresholds, reward and legacy four-tuple step, with placeholder dynamic constants. NOT COVERED: the upstream Webots R2021a simulation itself was never run (Webots, gym, numpy and stable_baselines3 were not installed), no sim backend is offered because WebotsStickEnv is not registered with gymnasium.make and its Supervisor base exists only inside Webots, and the fake was never compared with a Webots run. timestep_ms is 0 because the Webots basic time step is not stated in the clone (WorldInfo has no basicTimeStep); one tick is one controller step, not a physical duration. The seed is recorded by the bridge but the upstream reset is fixed at zero, so determinism exact covers only the fake's same-start same-action replay. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the pending seed makes no native call), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for close (the Gymnasium environment interface, absent from the legacy class), and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and seed on reset and seed. The clone has no LICENSE or README, so the licence stays NOASSERTION (unknown); the publish review is required. This package is model-authored and unreviewed, and no hardware was attached or claimed.
